findings.summary: Hero header uses borderRadius 24 and inner icon radius 17, deviating from the design system's card radius (20) and neighboring Cards.
findings.fix: Use BorderRadius.circular(20) for the hero container to match the standard card radius, and align the icon container radius (e.g. 16) with the input/button radius convention for visual consistency.

findings.summary: The chevron trailing icon on the tappable 'ملفات أعضاء الفريق' ListTile has no semantic hint, and the row relies on a visual chevron only.
findings.fix: Wrap the ListTile action in a Semantics(button: true, label: 'ملفات أعضاء الفريق') or add a tooltip/semanticLabel to the trailing Icon so screen readers announce it as a navigation action.

findings.summary: The error state interpolates the raw exception ($error) into user-facing text, which can leak stack/technical detail and is inconsistent with a clean localized message.
findings.fix: Show a fixed localized message like 'تعذر تحميل بيانات الفريق' and keep the retry button; log the raw error separately instead of rendering it in the UI.

findings.summary: The pushed team screen builds a bare AppBar with only a text title and no brand mark, unlike branded app bars elsewhere.
findings.fix: Add a BrandLogoMark (from core/widgets/brand_logo.dart) as a leading/title adornment on the pushed Scaffold's AppBar for brand consistency.

findings.summary: The second ListTile ('الموافقات والتقييمات') looks actionable (same layout as the tappable tile above) but has no onTap, which can read as a broken/dead action.
findings.fix: Visually differentiate the non-interactive tile (e.g. remove the CircleAvatar emphasis or add an informational style) or make it navigate, so tappable vs informational rows are distinguishable.
